description: This file defines a decorator class CachedCatalogItemServiceDecorator that implements ICatalogItemService to add caching behavior using local storage for catalog items in a Blazor web application.

classes.name: CachedCatalogItemServiceDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class implementing ICatalogItemService to add caching functionality with local storage.

methods.name: ListPaged
methods.description: Returns a paged list of catalog items, using cache if available and fresh.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Returns the full list of catalog items, using cache if available and fresh.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves a catalog item by its ID from the cached list.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new catalog item via the underlying service and refreshes cache.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Edits an existing catalog item and refreshes cache.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a catalog item by ID and refreshes cache.

methods.name: RefreshLocalStorageList
methods.description: Refreshes the local storage cache with the latest list of catalog items.
